reviews.review:
It's good but, there comes a certain time where you need to step away and stop (at least for me).

I came back, had loads of fun, and finally got to the fashion frame era of the game but... now I have no real reason to keep going aside from feeling the urge to drain my wallet on the game. It's not a bad game by any means, it's actually doing the best it has been in a long time. I just sadly no longer can justify playing the game anymore, my journey ended. Even with new content being added it just feels like it doesn't really change what the endgame is.

And that's a big thing. What is the endgame? Well... there isn't one, it's just when you decide the game ends for you. I've just finally reached mine.

At the end of the day though, if you're a new player, this is the time to finally get into Warframe as so many things have changed for the better to ease the grind for the most part.

Good fun frantic shoot-em-up fun.
Would recommend.
1k hours in and i still have no clue to mod properly 10/10

I think after 300+ hours on this game its safe for me to say that this game is simply amazing!!
Warframe has been one of the few games i have ever played that has really been keeping me engaged for months now! There is a absolutely overwhelming amount of stuff to do in this game, so its safe to say that you wont be completing it anytime soon. The story/lore itself is also just absolutely amazing and something i did not expect from a free game, there is so much to learn and the story goes very deep and is very interesting!
Its also one of the only free games that does not shove microtransactions constantly in your face, in fact in warframe you can even earn the premium currency by just playing the game! You never need to spend a dime on warframe in order to progress if you dont want too! After 300+ hours of playing i would honestly only suggest to just not grind too much, remember to take brakes because this game is super addicting!!
One of the best best free to play games out there!
